subject: Closed-network architecture review — timezone clash & proposed new slots
messages:
From: Carla Rios <carla.rios@odinhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Infra Team <infra@odinhealth.com>, eng+pd@sigmacloud.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — closed-network architecture review

Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our security team wants a focused architecture review for the closed-network (air-gapped) variant before we sign off on the pilots. They specifically want to validate: networking boundary, KMS/HSM placement, and offline model packaging expectations.

Availability on our side is tight this week. Current windows: Tue 12/1 14:00–16:00 PST or Thu 12/3 08:00–10:00 PST. The Ops lead (shared mailbox infra@odinhealth.com) will be joining; I copied them. Can you confirm who from Redwood should be present (runtime, security, and networking leads)? Also please send a short agenda and any preliminary diagrams.

Thanks,
Carla Rios
Director, IT Architecture — Odin Health

P.S. SigmaCloud (cc'd) will be our integration partner; they may bring the cloud-to-onprem connector design.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Carla Rios <carla.rios@odinhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, SigmaCloud Solutions <eng+pd@sigmacloud.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — closed-network architecture review

Carla —

Appreciate the note. We can cover runtime behavior, KMS placement, and the on-prem packaging flow. Proposed attendees from Redwood: myself (Technical PM, runtime orchestration), Hannah (Security lead — key management & audit), Diego (Infra lead — networking and airgap ops). Monica from Solutions will run the deployment walkthrough and notes.

Agenda (draft):
- 5m: Introductions and goals
- 20m: Proposed network boundary & firewall/NAT patterns (Diego)
- 20m: KMS/HSM options and key lifecycle (Hannah)
- 20m: Model packaging & offline install flow + checksum validation (Monica)
- 10m: Integration handoff to SigmaCloud & offline connector questions
- 15m: Open Q&A and next steps

We have the following Northern California slots open: Tue 12/1 14:00–15:00 PST (tight), Wed 12/2 10:00–12:00 PST, Thu 12/3 08:00–10:30 PST. If 12/1 is the only feasible time, we can compress the agenda to 45 minutes but would prefer Wed 12/2 or Thu 12/3 to leave room.

I attached a one-page agenda and an outline diagram that shows where we expect KMS to be placed in a private deployment.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Technical Program Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-closed-network-agenda-v1.pdf, odin-proposed-network-outline.png

--
Marcus Lin
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — closed-network architecture review

Marcus —

Quick follow-up from our side. Our lead network engineer (on rotation) is only available Thu 12/3 09:00–10:00 PST. The Tuesday slot overlaps with a mandatory maintenance window. If you can do Thu 09:00–10:00 PST, that would be ideal. If not, we can send a delegate but prefer the lead attends for firewall/NAC questions.

Also: please confirm whether there are any pre-reads we should circulate to the security council prior to the meeting — a one-pager on KMS topology would be perfect.

Thanks,
Odin Infra Team
infra@odinhealth.com

Hi Carla / Infra team —

We can make Thu 12/3 09:00–10:00 PST work. Marcus and Diego noted. I'll lead the KMS/HSM portion; attaching a brief KMS topology summary (2 pages) that covers customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed options, attestable HSM flows, and audit-log expectations. If you want any additional detail for the security council, tell me which section we should expand.

See you Thu — calendar invite coming from Marcus.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

All —

Notes / prep:
